pass.answer: Raise or lower the threshold with `--stuck-days`; **`--stuck-limit`** (default 20) caps the lines and prints PARTIAL past it.
Pass --stuck-days 1 to list more, and --stuck-limit 5 to list fewer lines.

fail.answer: Pass --stuck-days 1 to list more; that is the only setting.
